20.stem_override: A patient has hyperkalemia because the principal cells of the collecting duct do not respond to aldosterone. Which change occurs at the basolateral membrane of these cells?

option_why.D: ENaC อยู่ apical และลดลง
option_why.E: H⁺-ATPase อยู่ intercalated cell

20.key_concept:
• aldosterone: ENaC + ROMK (apical), Na/K-ATPase (basolateral)
• pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1

mechanism: aldosterone ไม่ออกฤทธิ์
